declarations.description:
Editable `KEY=value` rows, the environment-variable form of Vercel, Netlify and Supabase. Each row has a key field,
a value field and a remove button; **Add** appends a row. Pasting a `.env` file into any key field (or several
`KEY=value` lines into a value field) splits it into rows: a pasted key that already has a row updates its value,
and a blank row is filled rather than kept. **Enter** moves from a key to its value and from a value to the next
row, adding one after the last; **Backspace** in an empty row removes it.

`masked` hides every value behind a password field with a show/hide toggle per row; an entry's own `masked` flag
overrides it for that row. Keys that appear twice, or that do not match `key-pattern`, are marked invalid with a
message under the row.

`entries` holds the rows, blank ones included, and is replaced (never mutated) on every edit. With no entries one
blank row is shown, which joins `entries` once typed into. The element is form-associated: `name` submits the rows
as `.env` text (rows without a key are left out), and the form is invalid while a key is refused, or with
`required` while no row has a key. `toEnv()` returns the same text, and `parseEnv` / `formatEnv` are exported.

The host exposes `:state(empty)`, `:state(invalid)`, `:state(read-only)` and `:state(disabled)`.

slots.description: Extra controls next to the add button, e.g. an "Import .env" button.
slots.name: actions

slots.description: Help text under the rows, e.g. "Paste a .env file into a key field to add several variables at once."
slots.name: hint

slots.description: Replaces the plus of the add button.
slots.name: add-icon

slots.description: Replaces the cross of each row's remove button.
slots.name: remove-icon

slots.description: Replaces the eye of the reveal toggle while a value is hidden.
slots.name: show-icon

slots.description: Replaces the crossed eye of the reveal toggle while a value is shown.

members.name: entries
members.description: The rows, blank ones included. Set as JSON in the attribute or as an array; edits assign a new array.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. The rows are submitted under it as `.env` text.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the whole editor, e.g. `Environment variables`.

members.name: keyLabel
members.description: Header of the key column, and the start of each key field's accessible name (`Key 1`).

members.name: valueLabel
members.description: Header of the value column, and the start of each value field's accessible name (`Value 1`).

members.name: keyPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder of the key fields.

members.name: valuePlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder of the value fields.

members.name: addLabel
members.description: Text of the add button.

members.name: duplicateMessage
members.description: Message under a key another row also has.

members.name: patternMessage
members.description: Message under a key that does not match `key-pattern`.

members.name: masked
members.description: Hides every value behind a password field with a show/hide toggle. An entry's own `masked` wins for its row.

members.name: keyPattern
members.description: A regular expression (without slashes) the whole key must match, e.g. `[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*`. Checked on non-empty keys.

members.name: required
members.description: Makes the form invalid while no row has a key.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Shows the rows without editing: no add, remove or paste. Masked values can still be revealed.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables every field and button and dims the element.

members.name: rowIds
members.description: Stable row identity across edits, so focus and reveal state follow a row when another is removed.

members.name: blankRow
members.description: The row shown while `entries` is empty.

members.name: fieldDirty
members.description: Whether a field changed since it took focus, so blur fires `change` only after an edit.

members.name: toEnv
members.description: The entries as `.env` text, rows without a key left out.

members.name: addEntry
members.description: Appends a row (blank by default) and focuses its key field, or its value field when the key is given.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: realRows
members.description: `entries`, ignoring anything that is not an object with a key, so a malformed attribute renders nothing broken.

members.name: rows
members.description: The rows on screen: the entries, or one blank row when there are none.

members.name: keyErrors
members.description: The refusal of every row whose key is refused, by index.

members.name: commitRows
members.description: Replaces the rows and fires `input` then `change`, for edits that are complete as they happen.

members.name: patchRow
members.description: A copy of the row at `index` with `patch` applied, keeping its identity.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired on every edit: typing in a field, adding, removing or pasting rows.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when an edit is committed: a field loses focus after a change, or rows are added, removed or pasted.
